items.title: Dell, Super Micro Under Pressure as Nvidia Halts Shipments to 4 Asian Countries
items.summary: Server orders bound for four Southeast Asian countries are reportedly stuck, and a new U.S. export rule has a 90-day clock running. Which AI server maker has the room to wait out the delay, and which one does not?

items.title: Asian Data Centers Are Racing to Sell Spare Compute to US Buyers. That’s Bad News for Nvidia’s Next Orders
items.summary: Key TakeawaysA new US chip rule cut many Asian data centers off from their Chinese customers, and Bloomberg reports they’re trying to rent that spare computing power to American buyers. Each US lab that rents that capacity can mean one less new Nvidia order.

items.title: Singapore Reportedly In Talks With US To Retain Advanced AI Chip Access As Washington Tightens Export Restrictions
items.summary: Singapore is reviewing its procedures to prevent illicit semiconductor trading and will keep working with US authorities to address their concerns.

items.title: Market Chatter: Nvidia Stops Southeast Asia Chip Sales Following Proposed US Restrictions
items.summary: Nvidia (NVDA) has stopped some sales of its highest-end artificial intelligence microchips to Malays

items.title: Sandisk, Bloom, Marvell, AMD, Nvidia, HP, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market
items.summary: AI stocks are flying on Black Friday, with memory-card supplier Sandisk and data-center power provider Bloom Energy leading the way.

items.title: Mohamed El-Erian Says Nvidia Is “Too Big to Wobble.” Its Customers’ Data Center Plans Aren’t
items.summary: Key TakeawaysNVIDIA gave back about 40% of its post-Huang rally this week and trades at about 10x forward earnings, despite open backing from the Trump administration. Mohamed El-Erian says NVIDIA is “too big to wobble,” but agreed 2027 looks tough for the data center build-out.

items.title: Singapore yet to confirm if Nvidia has halted advanced chip shipments- deputy PM
items.summary: Investing.com-- Singapore has not yet confirmed whether Nvidia has stopped supplying advanced chips to the country, Deputy Prime Minister Gan Kim Yong said on Friday.

items.title: Nvidia halts server shipments to 4 countries just weeks after Jensen Huang’s affair with alleged spy was exposed
items.summary: It was unclear whether the halt would be temporary as Nvidia and its partners work through compliance requirements under new US export controls, the FT reported.
